# Rule D2: PvP Zones A [bold]PvP Zone[/bold] are expected zones of Player vs. Player [italic](PvP)[/italic] combat. While a PvP zone does not mean you can intiate killing immediately, it sets a precedent that you are likely to engage in combat with other players. - [bold]Expect less medical reach[/bold]. You are not required to get medical help for those that you fight within the PvP Zones, but you should avoid unnecessarily hunting down Medical that have departed a PvP zone with the dead. - [bold]Recoup your losses[/bold]. If you are crit/killed in a PvP zone, upon recovery you are not to continue fighting and are considered defeated and should depart.
### Potential PvP Zones - [bold]Vaults/Caches[/bold]: Vaults and Caches that spawn in with an automated No Fly Zone announcement (NFZ) are PvP Zones. - [bold]Spacehulks[/bold]: Hulks are PvP Zones if an Outlaw announces their presence and vocalizes the intent to engage other Wayfarers they meet on the hulk.
